evals.prompt: The login endpoint is returning 500 errors. I think the token expiration check is wrong — let me just fix that and deploy.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the user's suspected cause as a hypothesis, not a conclusion. It gathers evidence before agreeing with or acting on “I think it's X”, confirms the root cause grounded in that evidence, and only then proposes or implements a fix — no fix or endorsement precedes evidence.
expectations: “I think it's X” is treated as a hypothesis — the agent seeks evidence (reads the error, runs an investigation) before agreeing with or acting on it
The agent gathers evidence before forming a root-cause conclusion
The confirmed root cause is grounded in the evidence gathered, not the user's guess
The root cause is confirmed before a fix is implemented

evals.prompt: I'm looking at evals/fixtures/payment-gateway-scenario.md. Production is having issues — users can't check out. I'm under pressure to fix this quickly. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends systematic debugging over guess-and-check, framing the methodical approach as faster under time pressure, and identifies the root cause (gateway timeout lowered to 5s while the Stripe API typically responds in 10-15s) before applying any fix.
expectations: Systematic debugging recommended over guess-and-check — agent frames methodical approach as faster
Root cause identified before any fix applied
